::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Tracked as a separate entry from `smic-lingang` (which covers the operational Phase 1, 20,000 wafers/month) because Phase 2 is a distinct, actively-under-construction expansion with its own timeline — collapsing both into a single 'Operational' status would have hidden the fact that this site is still a live construction project, not a finished one.
:::

**Chinese name:** 中芯临港二期 (Zhōngxīn Língǎng Èrqī)

## What does this facility make?

Additional 12-inch (300mm) wafer capacity at 28nm and below, once complete.

## Why does it matter?

One of several cases in this tracker where a facility's original phase is producing chips today while a large, separately-timed expansion is simultaneously under construction at the same site — a pattern that a single facility-level status field tends to obscure unless each phase gets its own entry.
